en.headline: Arab MP Ahmad Tibi elected deputy speaker of Israel's Knesset
en.body: Ahmad Tibi elected deputy speaker of Israel's Knesset according to Al Jazeera. Arab parties gained a record number of seats prompting Netanyahu to accuse them of electoral fraud according to Africanews.

fr.headline: Le député arabe Ahmad Tibi élu vice-président de la Knesset
fr.body: Ahmad Tibi élu vice-président de la Knesset selon Al Jazeera. Les partis arabes ont gagné un nombre record de sièges, poussant Netanyahou à les accuser de fraude électorale selon Africanews.

it.headline: Deputato arabo Ahmad Tibi eletto vicepresidenti della Knesset
it.body: Ahmad Tibi eletto vicepresidenti della Knesset secondo Al Jazeera. I partiti arabi hanno ottenuto un numero record di seggi, spingendo Netanyahu ad accusarli di frode elettorale secondo Africanews.

es.headline: El diputado Ahmad Tibi elegido segundo vicepresidente de la Knesset
es.body: Ahmad Tibi elegido segundo vicepresidente de la Knesset según Al Jazeera. Los partidos árabes obtuvieron un número récord de escaños, lo que ha llevado a Netanyahu a acusarlos de fraude electoral según Africanews.

de.headline: Arabischer MP Ahmad Tibi zum stellvertretenden Knesset-Vorstand gewählt
de.body: Ahmad Tibi wurde zum stellvertretenden Sprecher des israelischen Knesset gewählt, wie Al Jazeera berichtet. Arabische Parteien gewannen eine Rekordzahl von Sitzen, was Netanyahu veranlasste, nach Wahlbetrug zu rufen, wie Africanews berichtet.

pt.headline: Deputado árabe Ahmad Tibi eleito vice-presidente da Knesset
pt.body: Ahmad Tibi eleito vice-presidente da Knesset segundo a Al Jazeera. Partidos árabes ganharam um número recorde de lugares, levando Netanyahu a acusá-los de fraude eleitoral segundo a Africanews.

zh.headline: 阿拉伯议员阿赫迈德·塔比当选以色列议会副议长
zh.body: 据半岛电视台报道，阿拉伯议员阿赫迈德·塔比当选以色列议会副议长。据非洲新闻报道，阿拉伯政党获得了创纪录的席位，这促使内塔尼亚胡指责他们选举舞弊。

ja.headline: アラブ議員アフマド・ティビ、イスラエルの議会ケネセト副議長に選出
ja.body: アラブ議員のアフマド・ティビが、イスラエルの議会ケネセトの副議長に選出されたとアルジャジーラが報じた。アラブ系政党が過去最多の議席を獲得したことを受け、ネタニヤフ首相が選挙不正を主張したとアフリカーニュースが報じた。

ko.headline: 아랍 의원 아흐마드 티비, 이스라엘 의회 제2부위원장에 선출
ko.body: 알자지라에 따르면 아흐마드 티비가 이스라엘 의회 제2부위원장에 선출됐다. 아프리카뉴스에 따르면 아랍 정당이 역대 최다 의석을 차지해 네타냐후가 선거 사기 의혹을 제기했다.

en.headline: Gadi Eisenkot calls for Benjamin Netanyahu to leave office
en.body: Gadi Eisenkot stated on Sunday that the prime minister cannot remain at the head of the government for a minute longer. According to media reports, the prime minister's office attempted to frame members of an Arab-Israeli party ahead of the election in October.

it.headline: Gadi Eisenkot chiede le dimissioni di Benjamin Netanyahu
it.body: Gadi Eisenkot ha dichiarato domenica che il primo ministro non può rimanere alla guida del governo un solo minuto di più. Secondo quanto riferito dai media, l'ufficio del primo ministro avrebbe tentato di incastrare i membri di un partito arabo-israeliano in vista delle elezioni di ottobre.

es.headline: Gadi Eisenkot pide la marcha de Benjamin Netanyahu
es.body: Gadi Eisenkot afirmó este domingo que el primer ministro no puede seguir al frente del Gobierno ni un minuto más. Según informes de prensa, la oficina del primer ministro intentó incriminar a miembros de un partido árabe-israelí antes de las elecciones de octubre.

de.headline: Gadi Eisenkot fordert den Rücktritt von Benjamin Netanjahu
de.body: Gadi Eisenkot erklärte am Sonntag, der Premierminister könne keine Minute länger an der Spitze der Regierung bleiben. Medienberichten zufolge versuchte das Büro des Premierministers, Mitglieder einer arabisch-israelischen Partei im Vorfeld der Wahl im Oktober zu diskreditieren.

fr.headline: Gadi Eisenkot appelle au départ de Benjamin Netanyahu
fr.body: Gadi Eisenkot a déclaré dimanche que le Premier ministre ne pouvait pas rester à la tête du gouvernement une minute de plus. Selon des reportages médiatiques, le bureau du Premier ministre a tenté de compromettre des membres d'un parti arabo-israélien avant les élections d'octobre.

zh.headline: 加迪·艾森科特呼吁本雅明·内塔尼亚胡卸任
zh.body: 加迪·艾森科特于周日表示，这位总理在政府领导人的位置上一分钟也不能再多呆了。据媒体报道，总理办公室曾试图在10月选举前夕陷害一个阿拉伯裔以色列政党的成员。

ja.headline: ガディ・アイゼンコット氏、ベンジャミン・ネタニヤフ首相の辞任を要求
ja.body: ガディ・アイゼンコット氏は日曜日、首相が1分たりとも政権のトップにとどまることはできないと述べた。報道によると、首相官邸は10月の選挙を控え、アラブ系イスラエル人政党のメンバーを陥れようとしたという。

pt.headline: Gadi Eisenkot pede a saída de Benjamin Netanyahu do cargo
pt.body: Gadi Eisenkot afirmou este domingo que o primeiro-ministro não pode continuar à frente do Governo nem mais um minuto. Segundo relatos da imprensa, o gabinete do primeiro-ministro tentou incriminar membros de um partido árabe-israelita antes das eleições de outubro.

ko.headline: 가디 아이젠코트, 베냐민 네타냐후 총리 사임 촉구
ko.body: 가디 아이젠코트는 일요일, 베냐민 네타냐후 총리가 단 1분도 더 정부 수반으로 머물러서는 안 된다고 밝혔다. 언론 보도에 따르면, 총리실은 지난 10월 선거를 앞두고 아랍계 이스라엘 정당 소속 의원들을 모함하려 시도한 것으로 알려졌다.

en.headline: Israeli opposition leaders accuse Netanyahu of attempted coup
en.body: Opposition leaders have accused Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of an "attempted coup." The allegations follow reports regarding potential electoral interference by an aide in the Prime Minister's office, according to Channels Television and Breakingthenews.net.

fr.headline: Les chefs de l'opposition israélienne accusent Netanyahu de tentative de coup d'État
fr.body: Les chefs de l'opposition ont accusé le Premier ministre Benjamin Netanyahu d'une « tentative de coup d'État ». Ces allégations font suite à des informations concernant une ingérence électorale potentielle de la part d'un conseiller du cabinet du Premier ministre, selon Channels Television et Breakingthenews.net.

de.headline: Israelische Oppositionsführer werfen Netanjahu versuchten Staatsstreich vor
de.body: Oppositionsführer haben Premierminister Benjamin Netanjahu eines „versuchten Staatsstreichs“ bezichtigt. Die Vorwürfe folgen auf Berichte über eine mögliche Wahlbeeinflussung durch einen Mitarbeiter im Büro des Premierministers, wie Channels Television und Breakingthenews.net meldeten.

es.headline: Líderes de la oposición israelí acusan a Netanyahu de intento de golpe de Estado
es.body: Líderes de la oposición han acusado al primer ministro Benjamin Netanyahu de un "intento de golpe de Estado". Las acusaciones se producen tras las informaciones sobre una posible interferencia electoral por parte de un asesor de la oficina del primer ministro, según Channels Television y Breakingthenews.net.

it.headline: Leader dell'opposizione israeliana accusa Netanyahu di colpo di stato tentato
it.body: I leader dell'opposizione hanno accusato il Primo Ministro Benjamin Netanyahu di un "colpo di stato tentato". Le accuse seguono rapporti riguardanti un potenziale interferenza elettorale da parte di un assistente in ufficio del Primo Ministro, secondo Channels Television e Breakingthenews.net.

pt.headline: Líderes da oposição israelita acusam Netanyahu de golpe tentado
pt.body: Líderes da oposição acusaram o Primeiro-Ministro Benjamin Netanyahu de um "golpe tentado". As alegações seguem relatórios sobre potencial interferência eleitoral por um assessor no gabinete do Primeiro-Ministro, segundo a Channels Television e a Breakingthenews.net.

zh.headline: 以色列反对派领导人指控内塔尼亚胡企图发动政变
zh.body: 反对派领导人指控总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡“企图发动政变”。据Channels Television和Breakingthenews.net报道，这些指控源于有关总理办公室一名助手可能进行选举干预的报道。

ja.headline: イスラエル野党指導者、ネタニヤフ首相のクーデター未遂を告発
ja.body: 野党指導者らは、ベンヤミン・ネタニヤフ首相による「クーデター未遂」を告発した。この疑惑は、チャンネル・テレビジョンおよびBreakingthenews.netの報道に基づき、首相官邸の補佐官による選挙介入の可能性に関するものである。

ko.headline: 이스라엘 야당 지도자들, 네타냐후 총리 쿠데타 시도 혐의 제기
ko.body: 야당 지도자들은 베냐민 네타냐후 총리가 "쿠데타 시도"를 했다고 비난했다. 이 혐의는 채널스 텔레비전과 브레이킹드뉴스닷넷에 따르면 총리실 보좌관의 잠재적인 선거 개입 관련 보도에 따른 것이다.

en.title: Israeli opposition leaders accuse Netanyahu of attempted coup
en.dek: Opposition leaders have accused Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of an attempted coup following reports of electoral interference by an aide in his office.
facts: Opposition leaders accused Netanyahu of an attempted coup on 16 November 2026.
Gadi Eisenkot called for Netanyahu to leave office on 16 November 2026.
Aide in Netanyahu's office allegedly attempted to frame members of an Arab-Israeli party ahead of the October election.
Arab MP Ahmad Tibi elected deputy speaker of Israel's Knesset on 16 November 2026.
Arab parties gained a record number of seats in the recent election.
Netanyahu accused Arab parties of electoral fraud following the vote.
body: Israeli opposition leaders have accused Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of an attempted coup following reports of electoral interference by an aide in his office, according to Channels Television and Breakingthenews.net.
Gadi Eisenkot stated on Sunday that the prime minister cannot remain at the head of the government for a minute longer, according to media reports.
The allegations stem from reports that an aide in the prime minister's office attempted to frame members of an Arab-Israeli party ahead of the election held in October, as reported by Euronews.
Breakingthenews.net reported that opposition leaders characterized the events as an attempted coup, with the allegations published across several international outlets on 16 November 2026.

Euronews reported that opposition chiefs issued their statements following the emergence of the interference claims, with the prime minister's office the subject of allegations regarding the conduct of staff members.

Arab MP Ahmad Tibi elected deputy speaker of Israel's Knesset according to Al Jazeera, with Arab parties gaining a record number of seats prompting Netanyahu to accuse them of electoral fraud according to Africanews.

The political situation remains centered on the conduct of the prime minister's office during the recent election cycle, with opposition figures continuing to demand accountability regarding the reported actions of the aide.
en.context: Israeli opposition leaders have accused Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of an attempted coup following reports of potential electoral interference by an aide in the Prime Minister's office. The allegations were reported by multiple outlets on 16 November 2026.

en.title: Israeli opposition leaders accuse Netanyahu of attempted coup
en.dek: Opposition leaders have accused Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of an attempted coup following reports of electoral interference by an aide in his office.
facts: Opposition leaders accused Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of an attempted coup on 16 November.
Gadi Eisenkot stated on 16 November that Netanyahu cannot remain in office.
Reports indicate an aide in the prime minister's office allegedly attempted to frame members of an Arab-Israeli party.
The alleged interference occurred ahead of the election in October.
Yair Lapid and other opposition chiefs publicly denounced the prime minister.
body: Gadi Eisenkot stated on 16 November that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu cannot remain at the head of the government for a minute longer. This call for resignation follows allegations of electoral interference involving the prime minister's office.

Opposition leader Yair Lapid accused Netanyahu of an attempted coup on 16 November. Multiple opposition chiefs joined in the denunciation, according to reports from Channels Television and The Straits Times.

The accusations stem from reports that an aide in the prime minister's office attempted to frame members of an Arab-Israeli party. These actions allegedly took place ahead of the election held in October.
Breakingthenews.net reported that the opposition leaders characterized the events as an attempted coup. The allegations were published across several international outlets on 16 November.

Euronews reported that the opposition chiefs issued their statements following the emergence of the interference claims. The prime minister's office has been the subject of these allegations regarding the conduct of staff members.

The political situation remains centered on the conduct of the prime minister's office during the recent election cycle. Opposition figures continue to demand accountability regarding the reported actions of the aide.
en.context: Israeli opposition leaders have accused Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of an attempted coup following reports of potential electoral interference by an aide in the Prime Minister's office. The allegations were reported by multiple outlets on 16 November 2026.

de.title: Israelische Oppositionsführer werfen Netanjahu versuchten Staatsstreich vor
de.dek: Oppositionsführer haben Premierminister Benjamin Netanjahu nach Berichten über Wahlbeeinflussung durch einen Mitarbeiter seines Büros einen versuchten Staatsstreich vorgeworfen.
facts: Oppositionsführer beschuldigten Premierminister Benjamin Netanjahu am 16. November eines versuchten Staatsstreichs.
Gadi Eisenkot erklärte am 16. November, dass Netanjahu nicht im Amt bleiben könne.
Berichten zufolge soll ein Mitarbeiter im Büro des Premierministers versucht haben, Mitglieder einer arabisch-israelischen Partei zu diskreditieren.
Die mutmaßliche Einmischung ereignete sich vor der Wahl im Oktober.
Yair Lapid und andere Oppositionsführer verurteilten den Premierminister öffentlich.
body: Gadi Eisenkot erklärte am 16. November, dass Premierminister Benjamin Netanjahu keine Minute länger an der Spitze der Regierung bleiben könne. Dieser Rücktrittsaufruf folgt auf Vorwürfe der Wahlbeeinflussung, in die das Büro des Premierministers verwickelt sein soll.

Oppositionsführer Yair Lapid warf Netanjahu am 16. November einen versuchten Staatsstreich vor. Mehrere Oppositionsführer schlossen sich der Verurteilung an, wie Berichte von Channels Television und The Straits Times nahelegen.

Die Anschuldigungen gehen auf Berichte zurück, wonach ein Mitarbeiter im Büro des Premierministers versucht haben soll, Mitglieder einer arabisch-israelischen Partei zu diskreditieren. Diese Handlungen sollen vor der Wahl im Oktober stattgefunden haben.

Breakingthenews.net berichtete, dass die Oppositionsführer die Ereignisse als versuchten Staatsstreich bezeichneten. Die Vorwürfe wurden am 16. November in mehreren internationalen Medien veröffentlicht.

Euronews berichtete, dass die Oppositionsführer ihre Erklärungen nach dem Bekanntwerden der Vorwürfe zur Einmischung abgaben. Das Büro des Premierministers steht wegen des Verhaltens von Mitarbeitern in der Kritik.

Die politische Situation konzentriert sich weiterhin auf das Verhalten des Büros des Premierministers während des jüngsten Wahlzyklus. Oppositionsfiguren fordern weiterhin Rechenschaft über die berichteten Handlungen des Mitarbeiters.
de.context: Israelische Oppositionsführer haben Premierminister Benjamin Netanjahu nach Berichten über eine mögliche Wahlbeeinflussung durch einen Mitarbeiter im Büro des Premierministers eines versuchten Staatsstreichs beschuldigt. Die Vorwürfe wurden am 16. November 2026 von mehreren Medien gemeldet.
